messages:
claire: Heads-up — my docs PR for structured-output.md is blocked. I wrote that the API enforces strict output validation by default (returns 400 with details). Runtime folks are saying hosted currently only emits warnings. Need a firm answer on the *default* behavior and how to document account-level vs request-level flags. @jordan @liam :eyes:

jordan: Short answer: prod hosted = lenient (warnings). Dedicated/private can be configured stricter. There is an internal flag DEFAULT_STRICT_OUTPUT that we flip in staging for testing but it is NOT flipped in prod.

liam: OK — docs should show both behaviours (current prod + strict override example). Also need to clarify interaction with tool/function calls: if strict==true and validation fails, do we abort before tool invocation?

jordan: We abort before tool-calls when strict==true. Implementation flow: run validator -> if fails and strict -> return 400 + validation details; if fails and lenient -> return 200 + body and include header `x-validation-warnings` + details in response meta.

kevin: We promised strict-by-default for GA in the roadmap. We should not state "strict by default" in docs until product rollout date is confirmed. Docs must reflect current behavior.

claire: Got it. Proposed approach: 1) Document current prod behaviour (lenient: warnings via `x-validation-warnings`), 2) Add example showing request-level override `"strict_output_validation": true` and 3) Add a short migration note: "behavior may change to strict-by-default; watch release notes". Sound OK?

liam: Yes. Also include SDK snippet showing how SDK surfaces validation errors vs warnings. For JS SDK: throw on strict, return {warnings} metadata otherwise.

jordan: Confirming header name: `x-validation-warnings` (JSON blob). Example lenient response: 
```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json
x-validation-warnings: [{\"path\":\"/output/title\",\"message\":\"missing required field\"}]

{ \"output\": { ... } }
```

And strict response: 
```http
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json

{ \"error\": "validation_failed", \"details\": [{\"path\":\"/output/title\",\"message\":\"missing required field\"}] }
```

claire: Perfect — I'll add both responses to the PR and include the JS + Python SDK snippets. I'll also add a short note about the internal env flag and that GA behavior may flip.

kevin: Please add an explicit callout that customers on Dedicated/Private may have different defaults set by their ops teams.

claire: Will do. One more question: do we have a public issue or RFC tracking the planned flip so docs can link to it?

jordan: Not public. We have an internal RFC (infra/strict-output-rollout). I can add a short public-facing "planned change" placeholder in the docs and link to release notes when available.

claire: Great. I will update the PR accordingly and re-request review. If CI/docs preview passes, will merge.

ci-bot: docs-preview: running -> linkcheck + spellcheck

ci-bot: docs-preview: linkcheck failed (1) — missing reference in migration note.

claire: Fixing the migration reference now, will push a small update in a minute. Thanks all :thumbsup:
